about.title: About
about.lead: Data → agents → physical AI, documented in public. The résumé is a component, not the centre. Foundation: roughly ten years in Data.
about.intro: Guillaume Verbiguié is building this Lab from Paris. The professional foundation below comes from a controlled experience record. Labs and projects are evidenced by public GitHub repositories. Nothing is invented: if it is not here, it is not a claimed experience.
professional: Roughly ten years as Data Analyst / Data Scientist / Senior Data Analyst — public sector, banking and retail.
End to end: requirements, ETL / preparation, analysis, machine learning where relevant, dashboards and restitution.
Data Strategy, Data Management, Data Governance, Data Culture — visible, not a logo cloud.
Managed 2–3 people at Ipsos (juniors / apprentices): real coordination.
Tools listed only when actually used (Python, SQL, Power BI, BI/data).
trajectory: TRAINING — Alyra: Ethereum, Solidity, smart contracts. Coursework, not blockchain employment.
2021 — public data-engineering training projects (Spark/S3 data lake, Redshift warehouse).
2025 — on-chain analytics as a data terrain (CSV dashboard, anomaly detection + MLflow).
2026 — agentic copilots and grounded RAG (Decision Copilot, Knowledge Copilot, automation agent).
Now — this Lab: bilingual, measurable, Physical AI as a direction without pretending to be a robotics engineer.
about.now: A public system to observe, learn, experiment and measure intelligent systems. SignalLab already collects raw metrics on Observe; scores and Ask My Lab come later.
about.notTitle: What this page does not claim
about.not: No robotics-engineer role, no invented agent clients, no skill bars. Alyra is not professional blockchain employment. Private repos (e.g. PhotoMind) exist but are not public evidence until they are opened or described with the same rigor.
about.scopeBody: Does this help understand, build, evaluate or apply intelligent systems? If not, it stays out of the Lab.
